forbidden: authentication, authorization, role, billing, provider, model, or workspace state in a browser cookie
document.cookie, Cookie Store API, or custom Set-Cookie handling
analytics, advertising, fingerprinting, replay, or cross-site tracking cookies
proprietary prompts, credentials, model keys, or privileged provider responses in browser storage
claiming a private or multi-user session before a verified backend and isolation model exist
notes: The current repository is a vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript SPA, not a secure authenticated control plane.
A future backend must define identity, tenant isolation, revocation, CSRF, cache, and cookie ownership before adding a session.
UI preferences should remain client-only and non-sensitive.
